## Your surface

`.devin/` is rendered in **mirror** mode: each file carries the full canonical body, because this tool ingests directory contents and cannot follow a path. What you read there is a copy — correct until it is not, which is why it is the one surface checked byte for byte.

## What that means when you work here

- This is the one surface carrying full bodies, because the tool ingests directory contents and cannot follow a path. Everything you read under `.devin/` is a copy; the original is the `agentic/` path named in each file's header.
- A mirrored body sits at a different depth than its source, so the generator rewrites every relative link for the new depth. A link copied out of `.devin/` back into a canonical body will therefore be wrong by one level.
- Because a copy can go stale silently, this surface is the drift-checked one: `validate_agentic_surface.py` V4 re-applies the generator's own transformation and compares, and V3 fails any mirror that has lost a STOP or CONSULT its canonical body declares.

## MCP

- Config path for this surface: `~/.codeium/mcp_config.json` — never committed.
- Committed example: none — there is nothing tool-specific to template.
- Servers this surface may not install without an explicit human decision: none are marked `user_confirmed` here.
- Nothing is installed automatically. `agentic/mcp_registry.yaml` declares each server's ceiling risk mode, and adding one is a supply-chain decision made on the repository's behalf.

## The mode contract

Every operation carries AUTO, CONSULT or STOP — the three are defined in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#auto-consult-stop) and mapped operation by
operation in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#agent-behavior-protocol). The mode is a
property of the operation, not of the tool running it and not of your
confidence in it: the same procedure carries the same mode here as on every
other surface, and a surface that appears to weaken one has drifted.

## Editing

Never edit a file under `.devin/`, and never edit this file. Edit the
canonical body under `agentic/`, then:

```bash
python scripts/sync_agentic_adapters.py
python scripts/validate_agentic_surface.py --strict
```
